newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP rises on strong BNP profit.
newsitem.headline: UAP rises on strong BNP profit.

text.p: Shares in French insurer Union des Assurances de Paris (UAP) and Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP), rose in morning trading on Thursday, benefiting from a surge in first-half earnings at BNP, traders said.
BNP holds a 16 percent stake in UAP while UAP holds about 14 percent of BNP.
Earlier, BNP reported profits of 1.74 billion francs in the first half of 1996 compared to 966 million in the year-earlier period.
UAP shares were up 1.45 percent at 105 francs at 0945 GMT, while BNP shares were 2.11 percent higher at 193.50 francs.
On Wednesday, UAP shares rose on rumours, later denied, that insurer Axa was considering a takeover of UAP.
